name: non-stationary
domain: 结构可靠度与随机分析
definition_zh: 统计特征随时间变化的状态。

complete_examples.text: It is a difficult problem to estimate the tail behaviors of nonzero mean PDF solutions accurately, especially at the non-stationary state.
The PDF solutions of nonlinear oscillators in non-stationary state were recently solved with the application of EPC method [37–39].
